verdicts.why: 34:55 is the only verse naming 'all the Canaanitish kings' delivered into our hands, which the note's own prose cites; 34:60 (gird on weapons, He will save us) has no kings; 34:56 speaks of the brothers' fears, not dread on the kings.
Whole Peleg clause is verbatim in 7:19; 7:18 is the Shem headcount.

'had begotten Nimrod' and 'when he was twenty years old he put on those garments' are in 7:29; 'And Nimrod became strong when he put on the garments' and 'he was a mighty hunter in the earth' are in 7:30, in order.
'all the earth was of one tongue...did not go in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord)' is 7:46; 'And he made gods of wood and stone, and he bowed down to them' opens 7:47.
'the garments of skin which Elohim made for Adam and his wife' is 7:24; the Enoch/Methuselah clause is verbatim in 7:25.
Terah-seventy / named him Abram clause is verbatim at the start of 7:51.
'when evening came the sun set as usual...Surely this cannot be Elohim?' is verbatim in 9:14.
All three pieces (saw the stars and moon / Surely this is the Elohim / these his servants are gods around him) are in 9:17 in order.
'Surely these are not gods that made the earth and all mankind, but these are the servants of Elohim' is verbatim in 9:19.
Both pieces (Rebecca's plea...hearkened to the words of his wife / Isaac stood up and prayed...because she was barren) are in 26:5 in order.
'came out red all over like a hairy garment' and 'called his name Esau' are 26:14; the Jacob heel clause is verbatim 26:15.
El Shaddai favor clause opens 29:28; the Abraham-blessing/multitude clause opens 29:29, verbatim.
Entire sentence is verbatim 12:24; 12:25 is the burned cords.
'Dan came upon the wall near to Judah' is in 39:42 (after 'And when').
Full sentence incl. 'Elohim (God) of your fathers' matches 47:5 verbatim.
'And the servants of the king went to Joseph...came before the king' is verbatim 48:41.
'where is Yahuah (the Lord)’s kindness with our fathers' is in 51:50; 51:51 lacks the '(the Lord)' gloss.
Both pieces ('Now therefore rise up and go to the man' / 'may El Shaddai (the Almighty God) give you mercy...with you.') are in 52:23 in order.
'slew Esau with a sword, and he cut off his head' is verbatim in 56:64.
'Zepho enticed Angeas king of Africa...with the sons of Jacob' is verbatim 60:4.
'put into a coffin in Egypt, and given into the hands of his children' is verbatim only in 62:3 (62:2 lacks 'in Egypt', 62:4 reads 'placed').
Trimmed quote is verbatim 71:13; the dropped Aaron lead-in is 71:12.
Full sentence incl. 'Elohim (God) of my fathers' matches 78:10 verbatim.
Sentence (with the doubled 'from' removed) is verbatim 80:62.
'ate of their sacrifice' is in 85:59; 85:58 has 'eat...our sacrifice'.
'Joshua rose up in the morning...passed the Jordan' is verbatim in 88:9.
Quote (minus 'THE END') is verbatim 91:17.
